_about: Amazon listings opened one by one in Chrome on 2026-10-15 (03:58-04:40 UTC) at plain amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> with no affiliate tag. Recorded: title, brand, selected variation, the listing's own variation list, details table, availability text. Prices were not read or recorded. Image file names were compared only; no Amazon images were saved. 159 of the 175 queued listings were opened; the run was then stopped by a browser permission check, so the last 16 are not checked.
